messages:
anya: Heads-up — doing a quick design spike on 'permission presets' for enterprise tenants. Goal: let admins apply a bundled set of roles + route scopes + quota overrides in one click. Want dev + infra input before EOW.

raj: Love the idea. Two quick asks: 1) presets should be able to include route-level quotas (not just roles). 2) we need a way to preview the effective API-level quotas before applying.

kim: +1. Also telemetry is critical — we should emit structured audit events when a preset is created/edited/applied. Suggest event name like `audit.event: role_preset.apply` and include actor/org/preview_diff.

dave: Implementation note from infra: console currently stores role bindings as arrays of {principal, role, scope}. For presets I propose storing them as a separate "composition" object (preset_id -> list of bindings). On apply we rehydrate into bindings to avoid changing the core binding schema. Keeps migration simple.

raj: How do we handle conflicts with tenant plan limits? e.g., preset grants higher per-route qps than tenant plan allows. Should we block, auto-downgrade, or surface a proposal to bump the plan? :thinking:

anya: UX idea: staged rollout modal — pick targets (org units or workspaces), percent rollout (e.g., 10%), and a simulation panel showing effective permissions and quota deltas. Add a single-click rollback/backout.

kim: Edge case: presets that include route-level admin privileges. We need an explicit warning and require a second confirmation (and audit reason). Also keep a simulated `effective_permissions.json` output so admins can export or copy.

dave: Backend API contract sketch: `POST /internal/presets/validate` with payload `{preset_id, org_id, target_scope}` returns `{allowed: bool, adjustments: [{route, requested_qps, allowed_qps}], errors: []}`. We'll implement validation + a dry-run apply that returns the set of bindings that would be created.

raj: Telemetry plan: emit `preset.apply.started`, `preset.apply.completed`, `preset.apply.failed`. Include fields: actor, org_id, preset_id, affected_routes_count, staged_percentage, resolution (auto-downgrade|blocked|applied). This helps build alerts when large changes happen.

console-bot: Reminder: any applied preset triggers existing config-change audit stream and will create an entry in the admin activity log.

anya: Great — I'll mock the staged-rollout modal and the preview panel. Can you guys confirm the validate API shape and telemetry fields so I can wire the UI? Will open a design + API PR tomorrow. :thumbsup:
